newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open higher.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open higher.

text.p: New York precious is called to open higher Friday as gold edged up in Europe overnight despite heavy fund selling and a strong dollar.
Overnight trading was reeling from a volatile trading day in New York on Thursday in which the August price ranged between $321.20 to $329.70 an ounce in heavy trading.
COMEX August gold was called to open $1.50-$2.00 an ounce higher from Thursday's close at $323.80.
Gold was fixed in London Friday morning at $324.50 an ounce, up from $322.50 Thursday afternoon.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks were unchanged at 883,196 ounces Thursday, while COMEX silver stocks fell 2,485,811 ounces to 173,143,586 ounces.
COMEX September silver was called 2.0 to 3.0 cents higher from Thursday's close of $4.28 after trading from $4.30 to $4.34 on ACCESS.
NYMEX October platinum was expected to open $1.00 to $2.00 above Thursday's finish of $412.20, with NYMEX September palladium called up $1.00 from the previous close of $189.50.
